verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of editable prompt/skill files (TDD, grilling, triage, setup) that plug into coding agents. It has no runtime environment, hosted service, or data of its own, so offering a sandbox versus production environment is outside this product type. Its TDD skill covers writing tests at agreed seams, but nothing in the evidence describes isolated sandbox environments or protecting production data, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.
